title: Site
description: Station metadata entity (technical specification 'Station' and 'Datastream' rows). Geometry is EPSG:4326 with latitude/longitude axis order (see the axis-order note in fixtures/contracts/stations.json). The internal block (gate codes, wiring notes) is server-side only and must never appear in a public projection; row visibility alone is not sufficient (FR-049). Stations carry a version used by PATCH /sites/{id} If-Match conflict detection.

id.description: Stable internal identifier. Display names are not identifiers and may repeat (see the shared-display-name fixture pair).

displayName.description: Human-facing label. Not unique; never a primary key.

externalId.description: Legacy identifier preserved in the provider/external-ID mapping.

systemId.description: Owning distribution system (or subgroup parent system).

visibility.description: Record visibility class. Public sites may still carry internal-only fields.

telemetry.description: Tri-state telemetry availability; unknown differs from absent/no telemetry.

latitude.description: EPSG:4326 latitude. Utah fixtures use ~41-42 N.

longitude.description: EPSG:4326 longitude. Utah fixtures use ~-111 to -113 (|longitude| ~111-113).

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version for metadata edits.

internal.description: Fields that must be stripped from every public/cohort projection. Presence of this block on a public station is intentional fixture coverage.

items.description: Datastream: station, observed property, unit, method, cadence and capacity limits.

validRangeMin.description: Inclusive physical/plausibility lower bound; values below are out-of-range, not merely suspect.

validRangeMax.description: Inclusive upper bound; values above are out-of-range.

timeZone.description: IANA zone used for display and day aggregation (America/Denver for Utah).

deviceDeployments.description: Effective-dated device deployments; a replacement closes the old deployment and opens a dated new one.

ratingCurvePeriods.description: Effective-dated rating curve versions with method labels.
